theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ → ∀ β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ), (∀ S, 0 ≤ β S) → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ t⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ z in closedBall x t ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (θ * (unitBallVolume n).toReal * β T))
